covers: The Motorola MC6850 ACIA serial chip as a chip

entries.name: MC6850 ACIA
entries.description: Asynchronous serial transmitter and receiver with a programmable word format and clock divide, driven by external clock pins.
entries.behaviour: Two registers, picked by offset bit 0: status or control at 0, receive or transmit data at 1. The interrupt asserts for transmit ready or for receive full or a DCD change, each with its enable, never in master reset.

handlers.read: register read; offset bit 0 picks data or status
handlers.write: register write; offset bit 0 picks data or control
handlers.write_cts: CTS pin level, shown in status bit 3
handlers.write_dcd: DCD pin level, sampled at the receive clock
handlers.write_rxc: receive clock pin; rising edges step the receiver
handlers.write_txc: transmit clock pin; falling edges step the transmitter
